services.name: All Safaris
services.desc: If you hear “safari” and think “wildlife,” this trip was made for you. Designed to maximize wildlife-viewing opportunities, this all-camping safari will bring you up close and personal with creatures big and small. Your guide will meet you at Kilimanjaro International Airport via your Delta/KLM flight and escort you to tonight’s accommodations in Arusha. As local Tanzanians, the guides know the country with unrivaled familiarity, so you’ll be in good hands from the moment you land. Reminiscent of its legacy as a former German colonial farm and coffee estate, Rivertrees Country Inn blends simple elegance and modern convenience. blurb: Guests experience wildlife safaris in Tanzania, including viewing flamingos, big cats, and other wildlife. Safaris can be tailored to include cultural interactions and other experiences.
